functions.name: has_nexora_permission
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_nexora_permission(p_permission_key text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select (select auth.jwt()->>'aal') = 'aal2'
    and (
      private.is_nexora_super_admin()
      or exists (
        select 1 from public.admin_staff s
        join public.profiles p on p.id=s.user_id
        join public.admin_permission_grants g on g.admin_user_id=s.user_id
        where s.user_id=(select auth.uid())
          and s.admin_level='assistant_admin' and s.is_active=true
          and p.role='admin' and p.account_status='active'
          and g.permission_key=p_permission_key and g.is_allowed=true
      )
    );
$function$

auth_storage_triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.protect_active_lifecycle_states()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM storage.bucket_lifecycle_states
        WHERE bucket_id = OLD.id
          AND NOT (
              continuation IS NULL
              OR (continuation @> '{"continuationVersion": 1}' AND continuation #> '{batch,inFlight}' IS NULL)
          )
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'update or delete on table "buckets" violates foreign key constraint "bucket_lifecycle_states_bucket_id_fkey" on table "bucket_lifecycle_states"'
            USING ERRCODE = 'foreign_key_violation',
                  DETAIL = format('Key (id)=(%s) is still referenced from table "bucket_lifecycle_states".', OLD.id),
                  SCHEMA = 'storage',
                  TABLE = 'bucket_lifecycle_states',
                  CONSTRAINT = 'bucket_lifecycle_states_bucket_id_fkey';
    END IF;
    RETURN OLD;
END;
$function$

auth_storage_triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.enforce_bucket_lifecycle_service_role()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF current_user::text IS DISTINCT FROM TG_ARGV[0] THEN
    -- Keep this check AFTER caller RLS accepts the proposed row. The API
    -- recognizes this exact signal after rolling back its permission probe.
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'bucket control columns may only be changed by the configured storage service role'
      USING ERRCODE = 'PST01',
            SCHEMA = TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,
            TABLE = TG_TABLE_NAME,
            CONSTRAINT = TG_NAME;
  END IF;

  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.protect_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Check if storage.allow_delete_query is set to 'true'
    IF COALESCE(current_setting('storage.allow_delete_query', true), 'false') != 'true' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Direct deletion from storage tables is not allowed. Use the Storage API instead.'
            USING HINT = 'This prevents accidental data loss from orphaned objects.',
                  ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.manage_nexora_user(p_user_id uuid, p_action text, p_reason text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ declare v_actor uuid := auth.uid(); v_target public.profiles%rowtype; v_permission text; v_staff_code text; begin if v_actor is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if; if p_user_id is null or p_action not in ('suspend','restore','cancel') then raise exception 'Invalid target or action'; end if; if p_reason is null or length(btrim(p_reason)) < 5 then raise exception 'A reason of at least 5 characters is required'; end if; v_permission := 'users.' || p_action; if not private.has_nexora_permission(v_permission) then raise exception 'Permission denied: %', v_permission; end if; select * into v_target from public.profiles where id=p_user_id for update; if not found then raise exception 'User not found'; end if; if v_target.id=v_actor or v_target.role='admin' then raise exception 'You cannot manage your own account or an Admin account'; end if; if v_target.role not in ('buyer','seller','porter') then raise exception 'This account role cannot be managed here'; end if; if p_action='suspend' then if v_target.account_status<>'active' then raise exception 'Only active accounts can be suspended'; end if; update public.profiles set account_status='suspended',updated_at=now() where id=p_user_id; elsif p_action='restore' then if v_target.account_status<>'suspended' then raise exception 'Only suspended accounts can be restored'; end if; update public.profiles set account_status='active',updated_at=now() where id=p_user_id; else if v_target.account_status<>'active' then raise exception 'Only active accounts can be cancelled'; end if; update public.profiles set account_status='cancelled',updated_at=now() where id=p_user_id; end if; select admin_code into v_staff_code from public.admin_staff where user_id=v_actor and is_active=true; insert into public.admin_audit_logs(actor_user_id,actor_admin_code,action_key,target_type,target_id,reason,details) values(v_actor,v_staff_code,'users.'||p_action,'profile',p_user_id,btrim(p_reason),jsonb_build_object('previous_status',v_target.account_status,'new_status',case when p_action='suspend' then 'suspended' when p_action='restore' then 'active' else 'cancelled' end)); return jsonb_build_object('success',true,'user_id',p_user_id,'action',p_action); end; $function$
